capture_recipe.dependency_membership_policy: AST and preprocessing depfiles must have identical independently parsed physical input membership; new/missing/rebound inputs refuse
capture_recipe.dependency_timing_tcb: First used-header pins only after original preprocessing. AST rereads original source/headers, not frozen .ii; exact original physical coordinates are required, with no invented .ii-to-.cpp mapping. Recheck known input bytes before and after captures, compare both depfiles, and retain frozen preprocessing only as provenance. Between-check transient filesystem changes remain timing TCB.
capture_recipe.oversize_policy: Refuse before accepting; no separate filtered-declaration ID joins or silent cap increases. A streaming/compressed successor requires independent source review and explicit root admission.

after each AST: same physical bytes and dependency membership
